title: Browser specs pass again after the UX round, so CI can deploy main
description: The first GitHub Actions runs (ARA-107) failed only at the Chromium browser checks, so the deploy job was skipped. The Playwright specs had not run since the UX round (ARA-083..ARA-110). A full local run on main 70d13ee against the deterministic fixture stack gave 10 failures and 1 flaky test: research E2E-02 and the 390px mobile shell; fulltext rate-limit retry and spent-allowance wait; local-models E2E-11 and E2E-12; mention pills ARA-096; multi-paper ARA-088; the Settings paper-details source; workspace E2E-03. User decision on 2026-10-10: "Fix all first" — deploy stays gated on the whole suite. User request: "Yes, can you investigate the deployment failure?"
acceptance_criteria: Given each failing spec, when it is investigated, then it is classified as a stale spec (the UI changed on purpose, citing the issue) or an app regression, and the fix keeps the spec's intent.
Given an app regression, when it is fixed, then the failing spec is the red test that turns green and no other suite regresses.
Given main, when CI runs on GitHub, then verify passes, including the full Chromium suite, and the deploy job ships main.
test_cases: Full Playwright run (research project, then chromium) on the fixture stack: all pass.
GitHub Actions run on main: verify and deploy succeed.
verification: Red: GitHub runs 38035168270 and 38073230139 failed only at Chromium browser checks (deploy skipped). Local full runs: 5 failed on a33bda7; on 70d13ee 10 failed, but that run reused stale e2e data because my zsh script never ran the reset (an unquoted $C is not word-split). Diagnosis: no app regressions. Stale specs: library link name gained the PDF state (ARA-098); ARA-109 save-on-select makes check() read the radio a tick early (local-models x2, Settings paper details); choosing the already-saved effort saves nothing; a just-finished summary opens in full (Collapse, ARA-102); the 'Models' tab also matched 'Open models'; mention pills put both titles first in the chat title (ARA-096/104). Races: Escape before Radix listens; a menu opened before the PDF loaded is closed by the toolbar re-render; arrow keys outrunning Chrome's asynchronous selectionchange (a debug run with paced keys selected and deleted the pill). After the fixes, a fresh stack (0 e2e volumes) ran 27 passed, 0 failed. Then GitHub run 38074979884 failed one timing-dependent backend test (a 50 ms pull budget that also covers the pre-transfer checks); a 1 ms budget reproduced it locally, a 2 s budget passes 6/6 with Ruff clean. GitHub run 38078713751 on 0356de6: verify passed (backend, frontend, contract, 27 Chromium specs) and deploy shipped main.
